Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in assays against human lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, join assays to target_dictionary on tid, and join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to 'lethal malignant brain tumor-like protein 1' and target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Return compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
